papers.title: Osteogenesis, vascularization and osseointegration of a bioactive multiphase macroporous scaffold in the treatment of large bone defects.
papers.abstract: Bone grafting remains the method of choice for the majority of surgeons in the treatment of large bone defects, since it fills spaces and provides support to enhance biological bone repair. Recently, we have reported our research on a bioactive multiphase macroporous scaffold with interconnected porous structures and nano-crystal surface microstructures that can release bioactive ions. Moreover, we demonstrated the excellent in vitro biological activity of the scaffold. In this study, we set out to evaluate the in vivo osteogenesis and vascularization of the scaffold in the treatment of large bone defects (10 mm radial bone defect in rabbits). In comparison with the control group, X-ray and micro-CT results at the 4th and 8th week post-surgery reveal that the bioactive scaffold displayed an enhanced level of new bone and vessel formation. Histological results at the same weeks indicated improved bone formation, osseointegration and new vessel ingrowth inside the bioactive scaffold. These findings establish a good foundation for the potential clinical validation of the bioactive macroporous biomaterial scaffold for use as a bone substitute or in tissue engineering.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及骨缺损修复中的骨整合，但未涉及增材制造（LPBF）或力学测试，与用户研究方向间接相关。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing, no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估多相大孔生物活性支架在大型骨缺损中的体内成骨和血管化能力。
summary_zh.method: 兔桡骨缺损模型，通过X射线、微CT和组织学分析。
summary_zh.result: 生物活性支架显著促进新骨和血管形成，骨整合良好。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the in vivo osteogenesis, vascularization, and osseointegration of a bioactive multiphase macroporous scaffold for treating large bone defects.
summary_en.method: A 10 mm radial bone defect model in rabbits was used, with assessment via X-ray, micro-CT, and histology at 4 and 8 weeks.
summary_en.result: The bioactive scaffold enhanced new bone formation, vessel ingrowth, and osseointegration compared to controls.
summary_en.validation: In vivo animal study with radiographic and histological evidence.
